passage.label: disbelieved People Scripture polytheists not parted misbelief until clear evidence came; Messenger Allah reciting purified scriptures; within correct writings; nor given Scripture divided until after clear evidence came

arabicExcerpts.text: لَمۡ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِنۡ أَهۡلِ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأۡتِيَهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَةُ
رَسُولٞ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتۡلُواْ صُحُفٗا مُّطَهَّرَةٗ
وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَتۡهُمُ ٱلۡبَيِّنَةُ

mainSubject.label: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted from misbelief until clear evidence came to them — a Messenger from Allah reciting purified scriptures containing correct writings; nor did those given the Scripture become divided until after that clear evidence had come

humanConditionsAndSpiritualStates.label: People of the Scripture and polytheists remaining in misbelief until clear evidence arrived

relationships.label: Messenger reciting purified scriptures with correct writings constituting the bayyinah

notes: Wave 13 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the division-after-evidence statement (4) before the pure-worship command opens (5); P2 is the single-verse definition of correct religion (5); P3 runs through the worst-versus-best binary and the closing mutual-pleasure reward (6-8).
